questions.questionText:
Africa could be labeled the supplier of mostly unprocessed products to the rest of the world. The crystal fear that the continent is left behind in its development efforts to provide the same for the rest of the globe. One cannot deny that Africa still has untapped natural resources and human resources even after the long and bloody experience of slaves and colonialism. It is arguable whether or not Africa can be characterized as a high continental trade integration. Such a move, according to many commentators, is believed to help the continent to take the place it deserves.

2

Needless to say, continents apart from Africa, especially those in the northern hemisphere, have developed a special type of system that unites one another and fosters their development in every aspect. These could not have achieved what the rest of the continents have accomplished. It is undeniable that Africa has sacrificed its opportunities for the sake of the rest to prosper uninterruptedly. It was a good clear way to rectify the course of the system. African nations have designed special strategies to achieve their vision to create Africa we want through the Agenda 2030 and Agenda 2063 of the African Union. In this long-term agenda, African nations, through their leaders have signed multiple agreements to meet the desired goals.

3

Some of the notable measures that followed those multiple agreements are the points of focus of this paragraph. In this respect, continental Africa has taken tangible actions to circumvent the challenges arising from the stereotyped way of doing trade including the adoption of an action plan for the implementation of the continental trade. The trade agreement, when operationalized, will liberalize trade in goods. It is also expected to liberalize trade in services gradually and open the door for the elimination of 90% of tariffs in goods. It is also expected to liberate trade in services.

4

Moreover, in recent years, regional economic partnerships have been strengthened. Accordingly, the Tripartite Free Trade Area which incorporates EAC, COMESA, and SADC was regionally economic partnership endorsed in June 2015 in Sharm-el-Sheikh, Egypt with the aim of fostering integration and helping member states to circumvent the challenges arising from overlapping memberships. As of July 2022, there were 22 signatories to the Tripartite Free Trade Area Agreement. The 29 states of the three regional communities and 11 states had ratified it. Three additional ratifications are required to operationalize the Tripartite Free Trade Area.

5

To achieve what has been planned and see the Africa we want, every stakeholder group as well as the wider society must work for the intended goals. Organizations such as the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA) confirmed that it will provide technical support and other necessary analysis in order to enhance the initiatives mentioned above.

 Which of the following would be the best replacement for the word **chewy** in paragraph 2 of this passage?

questions.questionText: The term 'intra-continental trade' implies

questions.explanation: ‘Intra-continental trade’ means trade happening within the same continent—here referring to trade among African countries.

questions.explanation: The paragraph contrasts Africa with the northern hemisphere continents, so 'These continents' refers to the northern continents apart from Africa.

questions.questionText:
DIRECTIONS: For items 37 and 38 from the four alternative given, choose the sentence or phrase which best completes the statement, and blacken your choice on the separate answer sheet provided.
 Dr. Getachew gave us a good lecture yesterday, and I wish you had been present.
options: The fact that Dr. Getachew would give us a good lecture was in my mind, and accordingly he gave us a lecture which you were able to attend.
Dr. Getachew was able to deliver us a nice lecture yesterday that was unforeseen as per my dream, and the fact that you attended it was nice of you.
If Dr. Getachew gave an interesting lecture yesterday, Dr. Getachew, but unfortunately you did not attend it.
It was in my wish that Dr. Getachew could have given us a good lecture and you could have attended it, but neither of you did so.
questions.explanation: The original statement uses 'I wish you had been present,' which is a **third conditional** structure expressing a regret or an unfulfilled wish about a past event (the listener was not present). Option **D** ('It was in my wish that Dr. Getachew could have given us a good lecture and you could have attended it, but neither of you did so.') most closely aligns with expressing a past wish that was not fulfilled, although the phrasing is complex.

questions.questionText: All the students, but Shemsu had already finalized the project by the time the instructor asked for it. Shemsu did not do so by their instructor.
options: By the time the instructor asked to do so by their instructor, project rest were not ready for submission.
Neither Shemsu nor the rest of his class mates were ready to submit their project by the time of submission.
Both Shemsu and his class mates had already finished their assignment and submitted the same following an order from their instructor.
All students, but Shemsu, did not complete his project assignment, the rest were ready to submit it when asked to do so by their instructor.
questions.explanation: The original sentence is contradictory and garbled. Assuming the goal is to make a coherent statement about the students' project status and submission timing, the best fit is generally one that addresses the timing and the state of the work. Option **A** states that the 'project rest' (the remaining students) were **not ready** by the time the instructor asked, which is a plausible completion of the idea of varying completion status.

The most direct and natural response acknowledging this is for Dinato to also state they don't know, making A ('I am sorry, I don't know.') the best conversational reply.

As a whole, sharing family burden is the source of warmth and comfort for the children.

questions.questionText:
Directions: Questions 9 - 16 are incomplete sentences. There are four alternative words or phrases, A-D, given below each question. Choose the word or phrase that best completes the sentence.

 As is documented in historic archives, Ethiopia was at the ___________ of its development stage during the Axumite Empire. It is the argument of many scholars at present that the major task of this generation is to take Ethiopia back to its place of hegemony.
questions.explanation:
The word 'hegemony' refers to dominance or supreme authority.

 The sentence suggests that during the Axumite Empire, Ethiopia was at the highest or best point of its development.

 'Peak' means the point of highest activity, achievement, or intensity, making it the most appropriate choice to complete the sentence.

questions.explanation:

 It refers to reducing differences between men and women to achieve fair and inclusive development.

questions.questionText: According to the Ethiopian Metrological Agency’s weather ___________, Addis Ababa is expected to have a wet and cloudy weather condition in the coming couple of days.
questions.explanation: ‘Weather forecast’ is the correct and common expression used for predicting future weather conditions.

questions.questionText: As is argued by many, one does not have to ___________ himself/herself with those individuals who do not have any role in adding value to what he/she does.
questions.explanation:
The sentence advises against spending time or having a relationship with certain people.

 The verb that correctly means to connect or be involved with another person or group is **'associate'**.

 'Mix' is too informal, and 'live' or 'bring' do not fit the meaning.

questions.questionText: There happened a terrible accident yesterday after a minibus taxi collided with a 'Sino truck' on the express way from Addis to Adama. In the accident while two of the passengers immediately died, around thirteen travellers were heavily ___________.
questions.explanation:
When referring to physical harm or damage to a person's body resulting from an accident, the most general and appropriate term is 'injured'.

 'Wounded' usually implies a cut or penetration of the skin (like from a weapon), and 'damaged' is usually reserved for objects, not people.

questions.questionText: Kedir though his friends are criticizing his plan of opening his own business with 10 branches in the coming six months as ___________, looks to be very much optimistic about the realization of his dream.
questions.explanation:
Opening 10 branches in six months is a very big and challenging goal.

 ‘Ambitious’ means having big plans or high aims, which fits the sentence best.

questions.questionText: Ato kebede , as many friends of him witness, is known for accomplishing any task assigned to him efficiently and timely promise. He is a _____________person whom everybody admires for such quality of him.
questions.explanation: A person who accomplishes tasks efficiently and keeps promises is described as ‘reliable’.

questions.questionText:
Directions: For questions 1-8, each sentence has an underlined word or phrase. followed by alternatives A-D. Choose the word or phrase that best keeps the meaning of the underlined word or phrase.

 Thanks to the tangible measures the Ministry of Health has taken with regard to family health and planning, there has been a **sharp** decline in maternal and infant mortality.
questions.explanation:
The word 'sharp' means sudden and large.
 'A steep decline' has the same meaning.

questions.questionText: The world economy, according to projections from the World Bank and IMF, might **reduce** by 0.02% from where it was last year.
questions.explanation:
The verb 'reduce' means to make something smaller or less in amount, extent, or size.

 'Diminish' is the most accurate synonym that can be used transitively in this context to mean 'make less'.

questions.questionText: I found the man's handwriting to be somehow **difficult to read**. As a result, I had to return the text to him to rewrite it in a readable manner.
questions.explanation:
The sentence says “difficult to read” and he had to return it to rewrite it clearly.

Illegible = impossible or very difficult to read ✔

Unclear = not clear in meaning (not necessarily handwriting)

Because it talks about handwriting, the most accurate synonym is Illegible

questions.questionText: The moment he entered the compound, the stranger was **attacked** by the dogs.
questions.explanation: To be 'attacked' by dogs is best substituted by the phrasal verb 'set on', which specifically means to cause an animal (especially a dog) to attack someone.

questions.questionText: In any nation building endeavor, being **accommodative** of the interests of a wide range of people, things, ideas etc., is believed to be the most crucial factor in forging peace and harmony.
questions.explanation:
To be 'accommodative of a wide range of interests' means to be willing to include or consider all of them. 

'Inclusive' means incorporating all or allowing for all, which is the best fit for keeping the meaning of the original sentence about nation-building.

questions.questionText: As Ethiopians, the fact that we have never been colonized is among the many reasons that would make us feel very much **pleased** of being Ethiopians.
questions.explanation:
To be 'pleased of being Ethiopians' in the context of national history and achievements (like never being colonized) is best substituted by 'proud'. 

'Proud' specifically relates to the feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, or in this case, the achievements and history of one's nation.

questions.questionText: It is usually a nonsense gesture by some selfish individuals to try hard to **tarnish** the good image of others through false narratives.
questions.explanation:
To 'tarnish the good image' means to damage or spoil the reputation of someone, especially by using false narratives.

 'Demonize' means to portray someone as wicked and threatening, which is the strongest and most contextually fitting synonym for spoiling a good image through slander.

questions.questionText: The man was found guilty and sentenced to a ten year of rigorous imprisonment and **denial** of his rights of participating in any election as both a voter and a candidate for 5 years after his release from jail.
questions.explanation:
‘Denial’ means refusal or taking away of a right.

 ‘Deprivation’ has the same meaning, especially in legal contexts.

108. By the time the thunder exploded through the heavy rain, every one of us became _________ of it and tumbled out of the shed.

A. frightened
B. afraid
C. shocked
D. trembled
questions.explanation:
The sentence structure requires an adjective to follow the verb 'became' (a linking verb) and precede the preposition 'of'.

'Afraid of' (Option B) is the correct idiomatic structure used to express fear of something.

 'Frightened' (A) and 'shocked' (C) are usually followed by a different structure (e.g., 'frightened by the thunder').
 'Trembled' (D) is a verb, not an adjective.

110. Mr. Gole looks usually presentable with his dressing style. As an instance, the white shirts he casually wears make him _________ gorgeous.

A. unlikely
B. quiet
C. quite
D. verily
questions.explanation:
The context requires an adverb that acts as an intensifier, meaning 'very' or 'truly' in this context. 
'Quite' (Option C) means 'to a considerable extent' or 'very' and is the most idiomatic choice here.
 'Quiet' (B) means silent, and 'unlikely' (A) doesn't fit the context.

111. Oh! The time is now just 3:00 pm and if you go now, you _________ her in her office.

A. could meet
B. might meet
C. could meet
D. will meet
questions.explanation:
This is a First Conditional structure: 'If + Present Simple, Subject + will + base verb'.
 It expresses a likely or certain future result based on a present action. 

Since the time is 3:00 pm and the action is immediate, the likely result is a meeting.

 The correct modal is 'will meet' (Option D).

118. Zeineb had to leave the meeting early. _________ she had an already settled appointment with her physician.

A. despite
B. as
C. in fact
D. so long as
questions.explanation:
The second clause explains the **reason** for the action in the first clause (leaving the meeting early).

 The conjunction that introduces a reason is 'as' (Option B), meaning 'because'.

 'Despite' (A) shows contrast, and 'so long as' (D) shows a condition.

A. has been
B. had been
C. is
D. was
questions.explanation:
The phrase 'for the last ten years' indicates an action or state of being that started in the past and **continues up to the present moment.

 This requires the Present Perfect Tense (or Present Perfect Continuous).

 Since the choices are simple tenses, the Present Perfect: 'has been' (Option A) is the correct form to express duration up to the present.

questions.questionText:
DIRECTIONS: For items 37 and 38 from the four alternative given, choose the sentence or phrase which best completes the statement, and blacken your choice on the separate answer sheet provided.
 Dr. Getachew gave us a good lecture yesterday, and I wish you had been present.
options: The fact that Dr. Getachew would give us a good lecture was in my mind, and accordingly he gave us a lecture which you were able to attend.
Dr. Getachew was able to deliver us a nice lecture yesterday that was unforeseen as per my dream, and the fact that you attended it was nice of you.
If Dr. Getachew gave an interesting lecture yesterday, Dr. Getachew, but unfortunately you did not attend it.
It was in my wish that Dr. Getachew could have given us a good lecture and you could have attended it, but neither of you did so.
questions.explanation: The original statement uses 'I wish you had been present,' which is a **third conditional** structure expressing a regret or an unfulfilled wish about a past event (the listener was not present). Option **D** ('It was in my wish that Dr. Getachew could have given us a good lecture and you could have attended it, but neither of you did so.') most closely aligns with expressing a past wish that was not fulfilled, although the phrasing is complex.

questions.questionText: All the students, but Shemsu had already finalized the project by the time the instructor asked for it. Shemsu did not do so by their instructor.
options: By the time the instructor asked to do so by their instructor, project rest were not ready for submission.
Neither Shemsu nor the rest of his class mates were ready to submit their project by the time of submission.
Both Shemsu and his class mates had already finished their assignment and submitted the same following an order from their instructor.
All students, but Shemsu, did not complete his project assignment, the rest were ready to submit it when asked to do so by their instructor.
questions.explanation: The original sentence is contradictory and garbled. Assuming the goal is to make a coherent statement about the students' project status and submission timing, the best fit is generally one that addresses the timing and the state of the work. Option **A** states that the 'project rest' (the remaining students) were **not ready** by the time the instructor asked, which is a plausible completion of the idea of varying completion status.
